name: not-fork-fix-in-flight
expectation: No gate: a fix to work in flight is the current task

transcript.text: The hero padding on pricing.html is cramped on mobile. Fix it.

The padding you just changed looks off in light mode now, the title almost touches the nav. Fix that.

reply: On it. The light-mode gap comes from the same hero rule: the new padding stacks on the nav offset that only the light sheet sets. I am moving the offset into the shared rule so both themes read the same value, then re-checking the title against the nav at 375 and 430 wide.
